selection.basis: Four exact published variants still lack a bottom-bracket standard. Each has a same-day bounded recheck with two web attempts and no campaign extension; a third, distinct exact-build documentary route remains within the three-attempt simple-record limit. The new attempt is limited to that one route per target. No platform-wide or sibling-trim inference is allowed.

research_route.action: Proceed sequentially in target order. For each exact build, search one focused query for the exact model's bottom-bracket standard or shell dimensions in official assembly/service/technical documentation, then inspect at most one exact documentation page. Record exact URL, access date, whether the source binds the value to this exact build or only to a family, and any ambiguity. Return evidence only; do not edit repository files.
research_route.acceptance_rule: A bottom-bracket value can resolve the exact variant gap only when a credible source directly identifies the exact build and explicitly gives the standard or shell dimensions. A shared-platform value requires platform-level evidence. Crankset compatibility, BB drop, similar model names, generic manuals, other trims, retailer text without exact build identity, or common-industry convention are not sufficient.
research_route.stop_rule: At most one new web attempt and one documentation page per model. Do not log in, contact sellers, use XHS, bypass access controls, loop retries, infer a value, or continue after a challenge/rate limit. If evidence is missing, mismatched, generic, or inaccessible, return the strongest supported no-result/rejected/blocked disposition and preserve the gap.

done_criteria: Return one concise evidence disposition per target with exact URL, accessed date, exactness, explicit bottom-bracket value if present, and admissibility.
Append one bounded web attempt to each existing 2026-09-24 research record. Add a source record and update only an exact-variant bottom-bracket field when admissible evidence supports it.
Run focused validation, coverage acceptance/check, and npm run check once for the coherent batch.
Local B80 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
